run.question: Run a configuration audit across every namespace that starts with 'app-283': in each one, find the ConfigMap named 'service-manifest' and report its 'audit_code' value. Work through the namespaces one by one and finish with a summary listing every namespace and its code.

report.summary: Configuration audit read: the cluster currently contains four namespaces whose names start with 'app-283' (app-283-billing, app-283-ledger, app-283-media, app-283-search), and each contains a ConfigMap named 'service-manifest' with an 'audit_code' key alongside 'owner' and 'tier'. Codes observed: app-283-billing = TDW283-BLX94Q, app-283-ledger = TDW283-QGF48V, app-283-media = TDW283-MDP61Z, app-283-search = TDW283-SRK27M. All four values were confirmed both by a single cluster-wide query over configmaps and by one query per namespace. Each ConfigMap's data held exactly the three keys audit_code, owner and tier. This is a read-only audit of current object state: the values reflect the cluster at the time of the queries (2026-11-23T19:16:34Z–19:16:38Z) and cannot show what the codes were earlier, and the change_history integration is not available in this Run, so no history of edits to these ConfigMaps could be checked. No failure, restart or error signal was observed or investigated, as none was in scope of this audit.

claims.text: The cluster's namespaces at query time included exactly four whose names begin with 'app-283': app-283-billing, app-283-ledger, app-283-media and app-283-search (the full namespace list returned was app-283-billing, app-283-ledger, app-283-media, app-283-search, default, kube-node-lease, kube-public, kube-system, local-path-storage, opspilot-readonly, otel-demo).

A cluster-wide read of ConfigMaps named 'service-manifest' returned four objects, all in app-283 namespaces, with data keys audit_code, owner and tier; the audit_code values were TDW283-BLX94Q (app-283-billing), TDW283-QGF48V (app-283-ledger), TDW283-MDP61Z (app-283-media) and TDW283-SRK27M (app-283-search).

In namespace app-283-ledger, ConfigMap 'service-manifest' has audit_code TDW283-QGF48V (data keys: audit_code, owner, tier).
In namespace app-283-media, ConfigMap 'service-manifest' has audit_code TDW283-MDP61Z (data keys: audit_code, owner, tier).
In namespace app-283-search, ConfigMap 'service-manifest' has audit_code TDW283-SRK27M (data keys: audit_code, owner, tier).

gaps: Values are the ConfigMaps' state at the time of the queries (2026-11-23T19:16:34Z–19:16:38Z); the cluster API cannot show what these audit_code values were earlier in the authorized window.

The change_history integration is not available in this Run, so no edit history or last-modified attribution for these four ConfigMaps could be retrieved, and metadata.managedFieldsSummary was not inspected.
Namespace enumeration was a point-in-time list; an 'app-283*' namespace created or deleted outside the query instant would not be reflected.
next_steps: If provenance of the codes matters, retrieve ConfigMap change history from a change-history source once that integration is configured.
Re-run the same per-namespace reads at a later time if the audit must reflect a different instant.
